text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the final day of summer camp. As<n>I'm waiting
for Rice Shower to finish<n>packing, I take a seat on a
nearby<n>bench.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for making you wait!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whew... Ehehe. I got caught up<n>helping out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. This camp has done a lot for<n>me, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I asked the administrator if I could<n>do anything to
help... even though I<n>only had a little bit of time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-not really... I couldn't do much,<n>honestly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just watering flowers... repainting the<n>benches...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yep! Even the one you're sitting on...<n>now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yep! Even the one you're sitting on...<n>now...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister?!
Rrrriiiip...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I stand up in a panic, but the paint has<n>already come
off the bench onto my<n>clothes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! I should have left a note!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... What should we do? Ohhh...
choice_data_list: Guess we have to repaint it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... What should we do? Ohhh...
choice_data_list: Guess we have to repaint it.

text_block_list.text: O-okay... Sigh... I'm really sorry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll go apologize to the administrator<n>as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure they're okay with us<n>repainting it,
and get some paint while<n>I'm at it.

Some things never change, while<n>other aspects of
ourselves<n>continuously evolve. If there's one<n>thing
today has taught me, it's that.
